svg.aria-label: The decoder writes one token per step. The prompt of 10 ids and the words written so far sit in a row; for the next token, self-attention looks back at the tokens so far and cross-attention looks at the 132 audio vectors that cover the whole clip. The decoder picks the most likely token out of 16,384, appends it and repeats until end of text
svg.text: 132 AUDIO VECTORS: THE WHOLE CLIP, ONE PER 80 MS
self-attention: looks at the tokens so far
append it and repeat, until end of text
